rows.quantityQualification: These pages have no per-vehicle quantity column. An illustrated occurrence is not proof of a complete installed quantity.
rows.name: Transmission case bearing retainer
rows.figureLocation: One at the input-cluster shaft end and one at the output shaft end.
rows.inventoryClassification: Separate part identity; current-model reconciliation required before adding duplicates
rows.modelingImplication: The factory table calls this a case-bearing retainer, not an oil-shield sleeve. Existing IDs are described as oil-shield sleeves and carry adjacent-year service callout 24; builder uses thin annuli at each shaft end. Matching number alone is not a valid crosswalk. Reconcile or relabel these existing candidates before adding two more annuli. Row 97 separately identifies an oil-shield sleeve 14020900 for 1984–85.
rows.furtherEvidenceNeeded: Original-year case-bearing installation/disassembly view and parts-group 4.104 usage/quantity table; compare group 4.422 oil-shield sleeve application and actual sleeve/retainer attachment details. No factory diameter or retention form is supplied here.

groupedServiceAssemblies.implication: Assembly includes springs and keys; independent modeled construction pieces should not become duplicate installed assemblies.
Same inclusion caution as item 22; not a reason to omit separately inspectable pieces or double-count service units.
Item 38 is printed N.S. and part of 39; item 37 is also part of 39. Do not treat all three rows as separate complete installed assemblies.
Source explicitly groups screw and washer; existing tx-reverse-bolt is a grouped selection, unlike separate row 58.
Aggregate label, not an additional missing monolithic part or an extra installed unit over its carrier/gears/bearings.

groupedServiceAssemblies.sourceNote: Note 1 says these parts are also serviced in group 5.527 gear kit 14045031.
groupedServiceAssemblies.implication: Service kit is not another physical gear set to add on top of its individual components. Preserve N.S. on pinion-gear row 83.

otherYearAndVariantFacts.implication: Do not spread this explicit 1984–85 row to every year implied by the broader figure heading; also do not confuse it with case-bearing retainer 24.

otherYearAndVariantFacts.fact: Fourth-gear rows preserve MY8 and M19 labels even though the heading says MY8/M17.
otherYearAndVariantFacts.implication: Preserve the source wording; do not silently convert M19 to M17 or choose an installed ratio from this overview.

otherYearAndVariantFacts.fact: Adjustment shims reference note 2: see chart in group for usage.

incidentalCorrectedReading.finding: NAT is 30 teeth, not a second 29-tooth color entry. Root independently opened the new render and corrected completion-transmission-speedometer.md; no app variant was selected.

conclusion.quantityFinding: The drawing shows two separate occurrences of 24 and one target occurrence for each other row. No quantity-per-vehicle column is supplied; installed quantity remains unverified.
conclusion.nextImplementationPriority: Correct source identities/avoid duplicate bearing-retainer geometry; then the distinct external selector lever/clip/pin/washer/nut group (90–96) and detent fastener group (58,63,64). Exact installation, adjustment and hardware dimensions require the further references named per row.
conclusion.currentAcceptance: Source report only. No claim that any missing geometry or service procedure has been completed.
